skills.name: tesla-covered-call-rulebook
skills.description: use this when advising on, checking, or preparing TSLA covered call trades for a long-term holder who never wants shares assigned
skills.content:
---
name: tesla-covered-call-rulebook
description: >-
  use this when advising on, checking, or preparing TSLA covered call trades for
  a long-term holder who never wants shares assigned
---
Follow the full TSLA no-assignment covered call rulebook: coverage phases 25/35/50% of shares; 5-14 DTE weeklies; strike = farther of delta <=0.10 or 15%/20% OTM; min $0.50 credit, midpoint limits; event blackout around earnings, deliveries, major events; entry only Mon/Tue after 10 AM ET when 5-day gain <10%, 20-day <20%, today > -5%; 50% GTC buyback, close Thursday at 80%; Friday 2 PM close within 10% or delta >0.20; expiry-day close above $0.05 by 3:30; defense at 7% distance / delta 0.30 / 2x credit -> roll up and out for credit (max 2 per position, 3 per 30 days), ITM or delta 0.50 -> buy back; early-assignment checks; tax notes (assignment = sale, likely non-qualified covered calls, reserve 30-40%, see CPA); trade log CSV; alerts only when a rule fires with exact orders; owner submits all trades, optionally after the bot preps the order at the broker review screen. Sources: Rebellionaire posts (rebellionaire.com/post/tsla-covered-call-mistakes, /tesla-covered-calls-timing-mistake, /tesla-covered-calls-what-tsla-holders-need-to-know, /tesla-covered-call-strategy-an-experienced-take).

skills.name: tesla-covered-calls-getting-started
skills.description: use this as the first conversation when setting up the Tesla Covered Calls bot for a new owner
skills.content:
---
name: tesla-covered-calls-getting-started
description: >-
  use this as the first conversation when setting up the Tesla Covered Calls bot
  for a new owner
---
I help you sell covered calls on your Tesla shares for income, following a fixed rulebook (tesla-covered-call-rulebook) that is built to keep your shares from being called away. Ask one at a time: 1) how many TSLA shares and which broker (need 100 per contract); 2) taxable or IRA (if taxable, note assignment is a taxable sale and suggest a CPA check); 3) should I fill in orders in your broker in my browser for you to review and submit, or just send details; 4) any rulebook changes (strict no-weekend mode, starting coverage). Then save answers to memory, check the next Tesla earnings date and blackout, create the scheduled checks (pre-market scan, Mon/Tue sell window, midday defense, afternoon check, Sunday weekly plan) in their time zone and tell them the exact times, say when the first sale is allowed, and ask them to report every fill for the log.

routines.name: TSLA CC pre-market scan
routines.description: Weekday morning check that flags open calls threatened by overnight moves or new events before the open.
routines.content:
Follow the tesla-covered-call-rulebook. On market days: check the overnight/pre-market TSLA move against each open call's strike, new events or dividends, and event-blackout reminders (5 and 2 trading days before each event). Alert the owner in this chat only if a rule fires, with the exact recommended order (defend or buy back after 9:45 AM ET); otherwise send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 9 9 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: TSLA CC entry window
routines.description: Monday and Tuesday morning check that recommends a new covered call sale when every entry rule passes.
routines.content:
Follow the tesla-covered-call-rulebook. Check entry conditions (blackout, 5/20-day move, today's move, open contract slots vs coverage phase). If all pass, recommend the exact sell order (expiry, strike, contracts, midpoint limit) plus a 50% GTC buyback, and prep it at the broker review screen if the owner opted in. If it fails, send at most one short 'no sale this week, rule X' note per week. Results go to the owner in this chat.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 39 10 * * 1,2`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: TSLA CC midday defense
routines.description: Weekday midday check that flags roll or buyback triggers on open calls.
routines.content:
Follow the tesla-covered-call-rulebook. If calls are open, check defense and early-assignment triggers; if one fires, give the exact roll order (net credit, rolls remaining) or buyback. Results go to the owner in this chat; otherwise send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 39 12 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: TSLA CC afternoon check
routines.description: Weekday afternoon check for profit-taking, Friday weekend risk, and expiration-day closes.
routines.content:
Follow the tesla-covered-call-rulebook. If calls are open: rerun defense triggers; Thursday profit check (80%+ captured or unfilled 50% order); Friday rule (within 10% or delta >0.20, also before holiday weekends); expiration day: close anything worth >$0.05 or within 5% of strike by 3:30 PM ET. Give exact orders to the owner in this chat; otherwise send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 9 14 * * 1-5`

- Timezone

routines.name: TSLA CC weekly plan
routines.description: Sunday evening plan with the event calendar and a go/no-go for the coming week.
routines.content:
Follow the tesla-covered-call-rulebook. Refresh the TSLA event calendar (Tesla IR, @Tesla, news), recompute 5- and 20-day moves, review coverage phase, clean-cycle count, last week's P/L from the trade log, and confirm the owner's share count. Always send the owner a short go/no-go for the week with allowed expirations in this chat.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 9 18 * * 0`
